body.heading: Where in the world is Federated States of Micronesia?
paragraphs: Federated States of Micronesia is a country in Micronesia, which is part of Oceania. It is an island country, surrounded by sea.

body.heading: The capital city
paragraphs: The capital of Federated States of Micronesia is Palikir.

body.heading: Words you might hear
paragraphs: People in Federated States of Micronesia speak English, Chuukese and Pohnpeian. Each island group has its own language — Chuukese and Pohnpeian are two of the biggest — and English ties the whole country together.

body.heading: Money in your pocket
paragraphs: The money of Federated States of Micronesia is the US dollar. Yes — the very same dollars used in the United States!

body.heading: How big is Federated States of Micronesia?
paragraphs: Federated States of Micronesia covers about 702 square kilometres of land and inland water.

body.heading: Two places we'd love to visit
paragraphs: Nan Madol is a mysterious ancient city built on 92 artificial islets in a lagoon — stone palaces and temples rising from the sea, called the Venice of the Pacific.
Chuuk Lagoon holds the world's greatest shipwreck museum — a whole Japanese fleet from 1944 resting in warm, clear water, now covered in coral.
